note: Check Input maps controlled gap terms to related Patterns. Useful Lenses are derived through the Pattern -> Lens matrix. Issues are not used as Check Input Step 2 targets.

primary.title: Authority Collision
primary.summary: A structural condition where multiple authorities claim governance over the same structural region without a declared precedence rule.

useful_lenses.title: Authority Overlay Lens
useful_lenses.summary: A diagnostic view that maps declared authority hierarchies onto observed structure to detect absence, override, or conflict.

useful_lenses.title: Conflict Lens
useful_lenses.summary: A diagnostic view focused on detecting unresolved contradiction, overlap, or incompatible structural claims.

useful_lenses.title: Invariant Lens
useful_lenses.summary: A diagnostic view focused on whether a required structural condition remains true across states, transitions, or executions.

useful_lenses.title: Reconciliation Lens
useful_lenses.summary: A diagnostic view focused on whether competing structural claims can be resolved into a coherent declared state.

results.caveat: These are related structural references, not a final diagnosis.
